facts.label: Win condition
facts.value: Go-out on the contract in 1 round

sections.title: The Contract (Boxes A & B)
body: When the match starts, a random 7-card contract is dealt to you.
Your goal is to drag cards into the two dotted boxes so the groups match the contract requirements.
To win, the boxed cards must match the contract and cover all 7 cards (extra leftover cards do not count).

sections.title: Your Turn (Draw → Boxes → Discard)
body: Take one card (from the deck or the discard).
With 8 cards in your hand, drag any cards into Box A and Box B.
If Box A + Box B now satisfy the contract (using all 7 cards), you win immediately.

sections.title: Strategy Tips
body: Try to build the groups the moment you draw cards that fit the contract.
If a go-out looks possible, focus on completing exactly the required groups.
Avoid boxing cards that block you from forming a complete contract.
